speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are a postmenopausal woman presenting with vaginal bleeding and an adnexal mass. To determine the cause, can you tell me how long you have noticed the bleeding, and is the mass painful or causing any pressure symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia with atypia or endometrial carcinoma. The presence of an adnexal mass in a postmenopausal woman with bleeding raises concern for gynecologic malignancy, possibly ovarian cancer or a metastatic process. I will proceed with imaging and histological evaluation to confirm the diagnosis.
